title: The Biggest Tree on Earth Grows a Whole 60-Foot Tree Every Year

scenes.text: Every year, this one tree grows enough wood for another tree.
It's General Sherman, a giant sequoia in California.
That's about 52,500 cubic feet of wood.
And each year it adds enough new wood to make a 60-foot tree. One tree, another tree's worth of wood.

description:
Every year, this one tree grows enough wood for another tree.
General Sherman, a giant sequoia in California, stands almost 275 feet tall with a trunk weighing nearly 1,400 tons, and adds enough wood each year to make a 60-foot tree.
Would you want to stand next to it?
thumbnail_text: IT GROWS A WHOLE TREE EVERY YEAR
